seo.metaTitle: SVG optimizer & cleaner — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Clean and minify SVG vector code by removing XML comments, editor metadata, empty groups, and redundant whitespace. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/image/svg-optimize-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: SVG optimizer & cleaner processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/image/svg-optimize-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does SVG optimizer & cleaner upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. SVG optimizer & cleaner executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/image/svg-optimize-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate SVG optimizer & cleaner?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/svg_optimize.json or open /tools/svg-optimize?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
